tagline: The pivot points of global power
description: Every war has a pivot point: the moment the balance of power moves. Fulcrum Brief explains the wars and crises shaping the world with maps and sourced numbers, and shows what each one costs you.
about: Fulcrum Brief covers Ukraine and Russia, Iran and the Middle East, Israel, the Red Sea, China and Taiwan, and oil and energy. Every claim is checked and every source is named on screen and in the description.
Each video finds the pivot point of a story, the moment the balance shifted, and ends on what it means for everyday life: prices at the pump, groceries, markets, security.
Based in the Black Sea region, close to NATO's eastern flank. New full videos every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

videos.title: Ukraine Is Setting Russia's War Money on Fire
videos.blurb: Nine refineries in one week, rationing at the pump, a deficit near double the plan. Why it still isn't a collapse.

videos.title: The First 72 Hours of a Russia-NATO War
videos.blurb: What the published war games show about the first three days, and why the weak spot is time, not tanks.

videos.title: Trump Is Flying to China With No US Carrier Left Near Taiwan
videos.blurb: Eleven carriers, none near China. What Beijing learns from a stretched US Navy.

videos.title: Trump Just Lost Congress… What Comes Next With Iran
videos.blurb: The strikes approved and called off, the January window, and what a divided Congress means for oil.

videos.title: What Happens if Russia Gets Its Own Starlink Over Ukraine
videos.blurb: Satellite internet changed the war. What happens if Moscow gets its own network over the front line.
